summary: Frontend-only testing (iteration_3) for Architect 2.0's two new flows: template auto-build and Deploy drawer. Both flows work end-to-end without any dead buttons or runtime crashes. Regression check confirms manual (non-template) projects still show the plan card and do NOT auto-build.

regression_manual_project.note: PlanCard's approve button testid is 'approve-build' (not 'plan-approve'); body contains plan text and no build timeline started automatically, confirming autobuild is scoped to ?autobuild=1 URL.

console_notes: Non-blocking clipboard PAGEERROR when clicking deploy-copy in headless context: 'Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied.' This is a headless-browser permission artifact only. Toast still fires and no UI crash occurs; safe to ignore in prod.
critical_code_review_comments: DeployDrawer clipboard write can throw in restricted contexts (e.g., non-HTTPS or headless). Consider wrapping navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch to avoid an unhandled promise rejection surfacing in the console; UX is unaffected but the console noise is avoidable.
ProjectWorkspace.useEffect that strips ?autobuild reads searchParams via closure with an empty dep array — fine here (100ms cleanup) but flagged as a potential stale-closure pitfall if logic grows.
ChatPane autoBuild path posts a hard-coded assistant intro ('Starting your {name} build now…'). Fine for scripted UX, just note the fixed copy per RFC.
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_seed_01 / user_id user_testseed01 (re-seeded via mongosh at start of this run).
seed_data_creation: Re-seeded users/user_sessions for user_testseed01 with onboarding_completed=true. Created two test projects during flow: one via template (SaaS Dashboard) which reached Live, one manual regression project 'TEST_manual_regression' that remained Draft with plan.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two mocked flows (template auto-build and Deploy drawer) confirmed working. Preflight animation takes ~2.6s; deploy timeline ~4.8s. Template build takes ~11s. If retesting deploy-copy, note clipboard API may fail in headless HTTPS-preview and log a PAGEERROR — this is not a real bug.
